**Downtime losses have surged dramatically since Q4 FY2026, with last quarter (Q1 FY2027) recording 1.83 Mt lost at a revenue impact of USD 48.7 M—nearly double any prior quarter—and the current partial quarter is tracking similarly high.** The step-change in Q4 correlates with a jump in down hours (4,734 h) that then spiked to 6,716 h in Q1 FY2027; SAP now captures ~52–56 % of downtime events (up from near-zero earlier), indicating better visibility into systematic failures rather than ad-hoc stoppages.

**Chain:** Higher down hours → higher lost tonnes → rising cost per tonne of downtime (implied USD 26.6/t in Q1) → margin erosion.

**Next step:** Drill into the SAP maintenance notifications covering that 55.8 % to identify the top two failure modes (e.g., crusher, conveyor) and execute a focused PM/reliability campaign this quarter.
